ground_truth.context: Table 1 ("Automating Air Quality Monitoring System and PM₁₀ Concentrations"), Panel A, column (1).  Non-parametric local linear regression discontinuity estimate of the jump in reported daily PM₁₀ concentrations at the date a city's air quality monitoring was automated; the running variable is days from the automation date, with separate slopes before and after.  Triangle kernel, bandwidth chosen by the Calonico, Cattaneo and Titiunik (2014) optimal bandwidth method.  No fixed effects or covariates.  Sample: all monitoring stations in the Wave 1 and Wave 2 cities with pollution data before and after automation, station-day observations 2011-2016.  Standard errors clustered at the city level.

cell.label: claude-code
deviations_manifest: rdrobust run with masspoints='off' (no mass-point adjustment). The R default ('adjust') gave bandwidths of 179/494 days; 'off' reproduces the paper's reported bandwidths (109, 263, 140, 234, 184 days; 7 months for AOD) and effective observation counts exactly, so it was adopted. Clustered variance vce='cr1' by city.

Panel A columns (3)-(5) use the residuals from the single full-sample residualization (station FE, calendar-month FE, linear weather) rather than re-residualizing within each subsample; this reproduces the paper's reported obs/bandwidths exactly.

Deadline sample (Panel A col 5) = stations whose automation date is exactly 2013-01-01 or 2014-01-01 (365 stations, 73 cities), the same definition that reproduces Panel B's 242 treated / 123 control stations; the paper says 84 cities, which no definition tried reproduced, but this one reproduces the reported 86,042 obs and 184-day bandwidth.

Matched event study (Panel B cols 3, 5): each 2013-01-01 station matched to the nearest (haversine) 2014-01-01 station with replacement; matched controls duplicated once per match. This yields 231,990 obs vs the paper's 186,499; several alternative matching constructions tried (common-date pairs, dedup, city-centroid, Euclidean) also failed to reproduce 186,499, so the literal construction was kept.

Monthly running variable (AOD, searches) = calendar-month difference between the observation month and the automation month (automation month = 0, treated). Search RD uses the earliest station automation date in each city and city-month means of daily Baidu indices and station weather.
cell.notes: All Panel A RD estimates, the AOD RD, the unmatched event-study coefficients and N (176,426) reproduce the paper's reported values/obs/bandwidths. Search RDs: 9.91 (mask) and 7.97 (filter) vs 11.03/8.73; sample sizes (8,661/8,590) match. Matched event-study col 3 is 51.8 vs 66.5 and log col 5 0.18 vs 0.24: the paper's matched-sample construction (186,499 obs) could not be reconstructed. Attempt-1 was data inspection; attempt-2 crashed (fixest dropped obs in AOD residualization); attempts 3-5 compared with claims and changed rdrobust masspoints, residualization scope and deadline definition (choices guided by the paper's reported bandwidths/obs); attempt-6 crashed on an undefined diagnostic column; attempt-7 was a diagnostic of matching variants (none adopted). No run hung. README.pdf in the mount was read (documentation only); no author scripts were present or opened.
